## pi-web-ui 0.6.1

This update improves feedback for the built-in `/reload` command and notification placement.

- `/reload` now shows a command bubble and an inline progress/result row in its conversation. The result includes extension, skill, and prompt counts, elapsed time, and hover details. Load failures show the affected path and error in an expandable row.
- Reload results stay visible after refreshing the current browser tab. They are not added to the Agent's context.
- Other notifications use the app's warm gray and purple palette and appear above the composer. Informational notices close after three seconds; warnings and errors remain until dismissed.
- The composer shortcut hint appears only while the empty message field has focus.

The matching npm package is `@youweichen/pi-web-ui@0.6.1`. Desktop installers are available for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Builds are unsigned; macOS may require right-click → Open, and Windows SmartScreen may show an unknown publisher prompt.
